Peat & Peaty soils.description: Peat and peaty soils. High organic matter, low fertility for arable crops. When drained, the peat subsides and releases CO₂.
Peat & Peaty soils.current: Pasture and grassland for dairy cattle. In some areas potatoes and onions on drained land.
Peat & Peaty soils.alternative: Legumes grow poorly due to low fertility and an unstable water regime. Prospect: paludiculture (crops on wet peat), which reduces emissions but produces little protein.

Sea clay.description: Marine and river clays of the polders and coastal areas. Heavy, wet soils with high fertility.
Sea clay.current: Cereals, sugar beet, potatoes, maize, dairy grassland.
Sea clay.alternative: Peas, field beans and soy: clay holds water well, but drainage and sowing timing matter, since heavy soil warms slowly in spring and waterlogs easily.

Sandy soils.description: Sandy soils, poor in water and nutrients, but well drained and warm up quickly.
Sandy soils.current: Potatoes, maize, rye and cereals, grassland. In some areas bulb flowers.
Sandy soils.alternative: Peas and soy are possible with irrigation and organic matter. Field beans are less robust. Yields are likely lower than on clay or loess.

Other.description: Soil type not assigned to a known group. Add a description to data/soil_info.json.

Kalkrijke poldervaaggronden; lichte klei.description: Light calcareous clays of the polders. Easier to work than heavy clays.
Kalkrijke poldervaaggronden; lichte klei.current: Potatoes, sugar beet, cereals, vegetables, grassland.
Kalkrijke poldervaaggronden; lichte klei.alternative: Field beans and peas grow well. The light structure suits early sowing of legumes.

Kalkrijke leek-/woudeerdgronden; klei.description: Calcareous clays with traces of an ancient forest soil (woudeerd).
Kalkrijke leek-/woudeerdgronden; klei.alternative: Peas and field beans: calcareous soil suits legumes. Check structure and drainage.

Kalkarme drechtvaaggronden; zware klei.description: Heavy clays with low lime content. Waterlog strongly in spring.
Kalkarme drechtvaaggronden; zware klei.current: Pasture and grassland for dairy cattle, cereals, in some areas potatoes.
Kalkarme drechtvaaggronden; zware klei.alternative: Sowing legumes is limited by late drying of the soil. Potential exists with good drainage. Field beans tolerate heavy soil better than peas.

Oopveengronden op veenmosveen.description: Sphagnum peat. Very low fertility, strong subsidence when drained.
Oopveengronden op veenmosveen.alternative: Hardly suitable for legumes. Consider wet crops (paludiculture).

Weideveengronden op veenmosveen.description: Peat on which pastures have traditionally been established. Water level is managed by drainage.
Weideveengronden op veenmosveen.alternative: Legumes are not recommended due to subsidence and low fertility. Paludiculture is possible if the water level is raised.

Moerige eerdgronden.description: Sandy soils with a topsoil of peaty (moerig) humus.
Moerige eerdgronden.alternative: Peas and soy are possible with fertilisation and irrigation. Field beans are less reliable.

Waardveengronden.description: River-valley peat (waard), often under a layer of clay or silt.
Waardveengronden.current: Grassland and pasture, potatoes in some places.
Waardveengronden.alternative: Legumes are limited by waterlogging. Selective replacement with peas is possible with good drainage.

Vlierveengronden.description: Peat formed in deltas and river floodplains, often with mineral admixtures.
Vlierveengronden.current: Pasture, grassland, cereals on drained plots.
Vlierveengronden.alternative: Field beans and peas are poorly suited due to low fertility. Paludiculture or extensive grassland is preferable.

Beekeerdgronden; fijn zand.description: River sandy soils (beek means stream), fine sand, fairly fertile.
Beekeerdgronden; fijn zand.alternative: Peas and soy are possible with irrigation. Fine sand warms quickly and suits early sowing of peas.

Kalkhoudende vlakvaaggronden; matig fijn.description: Calcareous sandy soils of the plains, medium-fine texture.
Kalkhoudende vlakvaaggronden; matig fijn.alternative: Peas, field beans and soy are suitable. Lime favours legumes; irrigation is needed in dry years.
